# Ax docs (agent)

Ingest in this order:

1. [card.md](card.md) — language card, ≤ agent context
2. [card.json](card.json) — same facts, structured
3. [protocol.md](protocol.md) — compiler loop
4. [api.md](api.md) — standalone REST generator

Rendered human view: [index.html](index.html)
Site root: [../llms.txt](../llms.txt)

Do not write Rust-shaped Ax. Write `#name(a,b)=a+b` or a `(` tree.
`ax hole --fills` returns compiling candidates only.
`ax-api` is not in the compiler; do not define `fn main` in an ax-api file.
